# Laura Clarke Administrative Services

> Jamaican paperwork, explained step by step. Laura Clarke Administrative Services (St. Catherine, Jamaica, run by Laura K. Clarke, a documentation consultant) helps Jamaicans at home and abroad sort out government paperwork and online portals. Free guides and checklists come first, paperback books on Amazon give every step, and Laura takes on a limited number of cases personally, all online. An independent private business registered with the Companies Office of Jamaica: not a government agency, recruiter or employment agency. Guides, books and consultations are information and administrative support, not legal, tax or immigration advice.

How to get help: send a short message on WhatsApp (+1 876-561-2614, text only) or email (info@documenthelpja.com) saying what you are trying to do and where you are stuck. No documents, photos or personal details in the first message. Laura replies yes or no and, if yes, gives the fee for the case. Asking costs nothing. Details: https://documenthelpja.com/consultation

## Books (paperbacks on Amazon, by Laura K. Clarke)

Working abroad:
- [Your H-2B Season: A Guidebook and Seasonal Planner for Jamaican Workers](https://documenthelpja.com/your-h2b-season), US$14.99. From the first call to the flight home: checking the agency and job order, contracts, documents and visa steps, money plan, weekly pay logs and the three-fourths guarantee, coming home and U.S. taxes.

Series "Self-Employed in Jamaica":
- Book 1: [Self-Employed Tax Record Planner – Jamaica](https://documenthelpja.com/s04-tax-record-planner), US$17.99. Every S04 figure in the order the TAJ portal asks for it. For self-employed people filing their own, or a preparer filing for clients.
- Book 2: [Don't Pay Tax You Don't Owe](https://documenthelpja.com/dont-pay-tax-you-dont-owe), paperback US$17.99, Kindle ebook US$9.99. Filing the S04 and S04A on TAJ eServices, screen by screen.
- Book 3: [The Sole Trader's Guide to Payroll: From Solo to Employer](https://documenthelpja.com/sole-traders-guide-to-payroll), US$17.99. Hiring a first worker: employee or contractor, NIS, NHT, Education Tax, HEART, PAYE, the monthly S01 and yearly S02.

The books are guides, not tax, legal or immigration advice.

## Consultations (case by case)

For situations that need a person: reading an H-2B job order, searching job sites the right way and writing to an employer; getting self-employed records ready and finding the way on the TAJ portal; online renewals; emails, letters and résumés. Fees start from J$2,000. More for research, calling or following up with an agency, or a written guide, checklist, letter or résumé. The exact fee is given before anything is paid. Laura does not find jobs, recruit or place workers, give legal, tax or immigration advice, or ask for passwords or PINs.

## Online renewal services

- [Passport renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaican-passport-services.html): online renewals for adults who qualify under PICA's rules. In Jamaica: our fee J$3,500 plus PICA's fee from J$8,850, courier included. Overseas: our fee US$70 plus PICA's fee and courier. Children's, first, lost, stolen or damaged passports and paper renewals are not handled.
- [Police record](https://documenthelpja.com/jamaica-police-record.html): the online application completed, the JCF fee paid and the fingerprinting appointment booked; the applicant attends for biometrics. Our fee J$5,000 plus the JCF fee.
- [Driver's licence renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/drivers-licence-renewal.html): the TAJ fee paid online so the driver has the receipt the same day. Our fee J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee.
- [Motor vehicle licence renewal](https://documenthelpja.com/motor-vehicle-licence-renewal.html): same-day online renewal when insurance and fitness are valid. Our fee J$4,000 plus TAJ's fee. The registration certificate comes by email.
- Traffic tickets: a free lookup of everything outstanding on a licence. Tickets that can still be paid online are paid for the client, even at the last minute when the tax office is closed: our fee J$2,000, separate from the ticket amount. Start on the motor vehicle page.

Fees were last checked November 2026 and can change; each service page shows the current fee. Other documents may be possible case by case: ask through the consultation page.

## Free checklists (PDF, no sign-up)

- [Before You Say Yes](https://documenthelpja.com/assets/h2b-before-you-say-yes-checklist.pdf): 12 questions before taking H-2B work.
- [Going Direct](https://documenthelpja.com/assets/h2b-going-direct-guide.pdf): finding real H-2B jobs and contacting the employer yourself.
- [H-2B Application Toolkit](https://documenthelpja.com/assets/h2b-application-toolkit.pdf): checklist, call script and scam card.
- [Before You Hit Submit](https://documenthelpja.com/assets/s04-before-you-hit-submit-checklist.pdf): 12 questions before filing an S04 on the TAJ portal.
- [Tax Backlog Recovery Guide](https://documenthelpja.com/assets/kits/tax-backlog-recovery-guide.pdf): catching up on missed years.
- [Client Papers Checklist](https://documenthelpja.com/checklist): every paper for the S04 on one list, sent by email.
